title: About ReelTale
description: Who makes ReelTale, why it exists, and how to reach us.
lead: ReelTale is a home for short, serialized stories: vertical episodes in live action and stop-motion, and living comics made with AI that you steer with your choices.

who.title: Who makes it
who.body: ReelTale is made by Euragnos B.V., a company in the Netherlands.

hackathon.title: Built for the Meta hackathon
hackathon.body: We built ReelTale for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon in 2026. Its AI stories are made with Meta’s Muse models and SAM 3.1.
